questions.question: God promised Israel that rivers would not overwhelm them and fire would not burn them. Why could they count on this?

answers.text: The LORD is their God and Savior
They have walked these roads before
They have finally learned to obey

questions.question: The LORD told Israel He would give nations in their place because Israel was what in His sight?
The LORD challenged the nations to bring their witnesses. Whom did He name as His own witnesses?
The LORD told Israel that other gods were formed before Him. True or false?
